description: Use for any "what is on" question in one city over a period, or to find an event by artist, team or name: city slug, date_from and date_to (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 14 days apart; default the next 7 days), an optional query and category. Results are sorted by date, at most 25 (total says how many matched). Each event has its name, date, time, venue, category, its TripHook event page (event_page: link this first) and its ticket link (ticket_url). When the reply has more_on_page, the TripHook page lists more events than this tool returns: always show that line with its link. For one day plus whether other travellers are going, use events_and_company instead. The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · What's on". Public fields only, never a person.

category.description: One event category, as on the TripHook event pages: music, sport, film, theatre, outdoors, food, talk or other.

city.description: City slug, the city name in lower case with hyphens, as in triphook.me/events/<slug>, e.g. "vienna" or "new-york".

date_from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the city's calendar, e.g. "2026-11-21". Default today.

date_to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 14 days after date_from and at most 30 days from today. Default date_from plus 7 days, no later than the last day of that window.

language.description: Language for the TripHook links, a code such as "de", "fr" or "pt-BR". Event pages exist in en, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru, tr, ja, ko, zh and ar; any other language gets the English page. Default English.

query.description: Words to look for in the event name or the performers, e.g. an artist, a team or a show: "rapid wien", "nutcracker". Every word must match; case and accents are ignored.

name: search_events
title: Search events in a city
